Subject: Vendr onboarding request — inventory + evidence

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this—Ventra is starting the vendor evaluation for our new inference stack and we need the vendor portal profile completed so our InfoSec team can validate controls. We've opened a request in Vendr with the core questionnaire and evidence checklist. High level asks: SOC 2 Type II report, CAIQ/consensus answers (if available), an up-to-date network diagram, and confirmation of logging/retention settings.

Portal link and request id are below. Would you be able to sign in and confirm an owner + ETA for initial submission? Our procurement deadline is end of month.

Vendr request: https://app.vendr.com/vendor/ventra-health/onboarding/req-4832
Request id: HS-1245

Appreciate it—
Gina Park
Vendor Risk Analyst
Ventra Health

Gina —

Thanks for the heads up. I'm assigning ownership internally and will coordinate the uploads. Preliminary plan:
- I'll pull the latest SOC 2 Type II report and our CAIQ extract.
- Naomi will confirm the network diagram and logging/retention statements.
- Aditya will validate that nothing sensitive needs redaction before upload.

Perfect — thanks Mateo. A couple of clarifications from InfoSec:
- They need the CAIQ responses exported as a CSV or PDF so they can map to our internal control matrix.
- Network diagram should show egress controls and third-party data flows (S3, audit log buckets, KMS).
- On logging: please confirm retention for audit logs (how long logs are kept, where, and who has access).

If you upload the SOC2 report we can mark the request as provisionally reviewed while the other artifacts are validated.

Thanks,
Gina

On a related note, if you have a contact for your Whistic/Vendr admin we can add them to the portal to speed the process.
